note: Direct proof architecture. Upper bound: fix v in K6. Of five incident edges, at least three have one color. For their three other endpoints, an edge in that color closes a triangle with v; if none has that color, all three mutual edges have the opposite color and themselves form a triangle. Lower bound: on vertices 1,2,3,4,5 color the cycle 12,23,34,45,51 red and all other edges blue. The blue edges are exactly the cycle 13,35,52,24,41. Each color class is a 5-cycle, hence triangle-free. No predecessor fact or external result is required.
